Name: WorkbenchAllChests
Author: ZengGod
Description:
[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]Module Introduction[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[color=#ffffff][size=4][b]      This mod optimizes how the crafting table, backpack crafting page, and cooking interface read storage containers. You no longer need to rummage through chests everywhere for materials, and settings can be configured in GMCM. The crafting table directly reads all chests in its area, so chests no longer need to be placed around the crafting table. It supports connected chests, chests near the backpack crafting page, and range selection. In single-player mode, chests currently in use are automatically skipped (all features have toggleable settings).[/b][/size][/color]




[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]模组介绍[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[size=4][b]      本模组优化了工作台、背包打造页以及烹饪界面的读取储物容器方式，以后无需到处翻箱倒柜找材料，可在 GMCM 中进行配置。工作台直接读取所在地区的所有箱子，不再需要把箱子围在工作台周围；支持连在一起箱子、背包打造页附近箱子与范围选择；单机下自动跳过正在被使用的箱子（均可配置开关）[/b][/size]






[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]1.0.1 Update[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Android compatibility has been added, and the mod settings menu has been optimized. [/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]To maintain balance,  [/size][size=4]“Backpack Crafting All Chests in Area” is set to off by default; [/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]“Workbench All Chests in Area” is set to “Read connected chests” [/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]by default, but players can switch and enable it themselves.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]1.0.2 Update[/size][/color][/i][/b]

[*][b][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS] add three options on the cooking interface: [/font][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]  1.read all storage containers in the current area[/font][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]  2.read all containers across all areas[/font][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]  3.only read refrigerators and mini-fridges across all areas[/font][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]disabled by default[/font][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[/list]
